About Me

Building ideas into working products.

A developer profile based on my actual education, training and project experience.

I’m Mo Kaif, a MERN Stack Developer and final-year Computer Science & Engineering student. I enjoy creating full-stack applications that are responsive, practical and focused on real-world problems.

My development work covers frontend interfaces, backend APIs, databases, authentication, CRUD operations and API testing. I learn by building and improving real projects.

I completed industry-oriented full-stack training at Techpile Technology Private Limited, working with React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, Postman and Thunder Client.
